blocked.title: Setup is locked on this deployment
blocked.subtitle: This Capka is reachable from the network, so the first account cannot simply claim admin.
blocked.why: Without a setup token, admin would go to whoever opens this page first — not necessarily you. Capka refuses that race instead of running it.
blocked.step1: Set SETUP_TOKEN to a random value in your .env file.
blocked.step2: Restart Capka so it picks up the change.
blocked.step3: Open the setup link again and finish — the token is checked when the admin account is claimed.
blocked.hint: Running scripts/up.sh generates the token for you and prints a ready-to-click link.

telegram.start:
👋 **Welcome to Capka!**

I'm your AI assistant right here in Telegram — I answer questions and work with text, photos and files.

Just send me a message and I'll get going. /new starts a fresh chat.

Already have a Capka account? Open Capka and connect Telegram in Settings.
telegram.startLinked:
👋 **Welcome back!** Your account is already connected.

Just message me and I'll get going. You can send text, photos and files, and /new opens a fresh chat.
telegram.tooManyAttempts: ⏳ Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
telegram.linkUsage:
Send the code right after the command: `/link CODE`

You'll find your connection code in Capka's settings.
telegram.invalidCode: 🤔 That code is invalid or has expired. Generate a new one in Capka and try again.
telegram.linked:
✅ **Account linked!**

Just message me and I'll get going. You can send text, photos and files.
telegram.newChat:
🆕 **New chat**

Your previous conversation is saved. Go ahead — we're starting fresh.
telegram.notLinked:
To let me reply, connect your account first.

Open Capka and sign in with Telegram — it takes a few seconds and links automatically.
